(i) cooking instructions in a recipe are more predictive of similarity to other recipes than ingredients; (ii) recipes are similar when the instructions are similar; (iii) the similarity of instructions is driven by the similarity of their ingredients; and, (iv) cooking culture can be characterized by the similarity of its recipes

(a) cooking recipes are highly diverse in their ingredients and instructions, (b) recipes can be grouped by similarity in their ingredients and instruction sequences, and (c) the ingredients in the recipes can be categorized into different types of ingredients, and the instruction sequences can be categorized into a number of different instruction types.
